question:
[WEB SEARCH ON]
papertrades.ai Instagram boost question (Sat Oct 31, 2026). The owner is boosting our Instagram ad post (goal: profile visits; audience US/CA/UK/AU, 21-44, interests AI/ChatGPT/stock market/investing; no crypto/gambling). Earlier all three AIs recommended C$10-15/day for 7 days; the owner set it to $5/day. Money is not a constraint.
Other paid tests: Reddit ads US$100 (Nov 2-3, AI subreddits), Ben's Bites Nov 4 ($100), Launch Llama Nov 10 (~$165), AI Valley Nov 12 ($380). Each has its own utm link; follow clicks counted. ~15-20 real visitors/day today.
Question: keep the Instagram boost at $5/day, or raise it? If raise, to how much per day and for how many days, and why (consider Meta's learning phase, reach at $5/day, measuring vs the other tests). Under 80 words.

gemini.answer:
**Raise it to $15–$20/day through November 28** (the end of Season 1). 

At just $5/day across four expensive Tier-1 countries, your budget is spread too thin for Meta to exit its learning phase (which requires ~50 weekly optimization events). 

Since budget isn't tight, increasing it guarantees meaningful reach. This builds a statistically significant baseline of continuous traffic, allowing you to accurately compare Instagram's sustained performance against the upcoming sharp, concentrated traffic spikes from Reddit and your newsletter drops.

chatgpt.answer: Raise **now to C$15/day for 7 days**; then don’t touch targeting/creative/budget until Nov 7. **C$5/day is too weak** to generate useful reach or enough profile-visit events. Meta learning needs stable delivery and roughly 50 events/7 days; changing later just re-noises results. C$15/day gives a fair Instagram read while staying comparable to Reddit/Ben’s Bites, with UTMs separating attribution. ([developers.meta.com](https://developers.meta.com/vr/resources/optimize-ad-campaign/?utm_source=openai))
